verdict.rationale: Docs show a real risk-management module — Continuous Risk Monitoring, Vendor Risk Assessment, configurable AI risk scoring workflows, and findings/tasks with assigned owners and remediation actions — which maps closely to a risk register with scoring, ownership, and treatment. However, there is no explicit mention of a unified 'risk register' view, formal treatment plans, or scheduled review cycles tied back to controls. Missing for 10: explicit risk register/scoring methodology docs, treatment plan workflow, review-cycle cadence, and direct control-to-risk linkage evidence.
